# Test the shift-based month counting logic manually
import arrow
from dateutil import tz as dateutil_tz

def count_months(self_dt, other_dt):
    """Count months between two datetimes using shift"""
    # Determine sign: -1 if self is before other, +1 if self is after other
    delta = (self_dt - other_dt).total_seconds()
    sign = -1 if delta < 0 else 1
    
    # Approximate month count
    approx_months = abs((other_dt.year * 12 + other_dt.month) - (self_dt.year * 12 + self_dt.month))
    
    months_count = approx_months
    if sign == -1:
        # self is before other, shift forward
        while months_count > 0:
            shifted = self_dt.shift(months=months_count)
            if shifted <= other_dt:
                break
            months_count -= 1
    else:
        # self is after other, shift backward
        while months_count > 0:
            shifted = self_dt.shift(months=-months_count)
            if shifted >= other_dt:
                break
            months_count -= 1
    
    return sign, months_count

# Test cases
arw_jan = arrow.Arrow(2023, 1, 1)
arw_feb = arrow.Arrow(2023, 2, 1)
arw_mar = arrow.Arrow(2023, 3, 1)

sign1, months1 = count_months(arw_jan._datetime, arw_feb._datetime)
print(f"Jan 1 -> Feb 1: sign={sign1}, months={months1}")

sign2, months2 = count_months(arw_jan._datetime, arw_mar._datetime)
print(f"Jan 1 -> Mar 1: sign={sign2}, months={months2}")

# Pacific timezone test
arw_pac_jan = arrow.Arrow(2023, 1, 1, tzinfo=dateutil_tz.gettz('US/Pacific'))
arw_pac_feb = arrow.Arrow(2023, 2, 1, tzinfo=dateutil_tz.gettz('US/Pacific'))
arw_pac_mar = arrow.Arrow(2023, 3, 1, tzinfo=dateutil_tz.gettz('US/Pacific'))

sign3, months3 = count_months(arw_pac_jan._datetime, arw_pac_feb._datetime)
print(f"Pacific Jan 1 -> Feb 1: sign={sign3}, months={months3}")

sign4, months4 = count_months(arw_pac_jan._datetime, arw_pac_mar._datetime)
print(f"Pacific Jan 1 -> Mar 1: sign={sign4}, months={months4}")
